standing:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production fighting-game sprite atlas for Chava. Reference image 1 supplies the existing pixel-art costume and proportions, image 2 supplies his face. Keep same recognizable tan face, short black hair, thick eyebrows, dark green polo white collar, navy trousers, green white black sneakers. 1990s SNK KOF 2002 pixel art. Crisp BLACK outer outlines, no white outline, no halo, NO antialiasing, no drop shadow. FLAT SOLID MAGENTA #ff00ff background, absolutely NO checkerboard. EXACT 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 full-body isolated sprites with wide empty gutters. Same anatomy and scale in every cell. All face RIGHT. Feet planted on identical baseline, hips registered to the same location. No labels, no text, no panels. Six chronological animation frames per row. Keep the controller tucked away during attack, held in both hands only in first/last ready pose.
ROW 1: RIGHT HAND straight jab, six frames: ready controller stance; shoulder loads with right/near fist at ribs; right arm half extends; right arm FULLY EXTENDED straight to the right at chin height, right shoulder forwards, LEFT ARM clearly bent guarding chest; retract fist; recover controller stance. Camera sees front of polo.
ROW 2: LEFT HAND cross, distinctly DIFFERENT silhouette from row1, NOT a repeated right punch or horizontally flipped character: ready; LEFT/far shoulder twists forward while right fist guards face; rotate torso to show MORE OF HIS BACK and drive LEFT/far arm across body; FULL EXTENDED left fist to RIGHT with deep torso rotation, near RIGHT ARM elbow bent in front of stomach; unwind; recover controller stance. Character still faces RIGHT throughout.
ROW 3: FIRST BACKPACK strike, strong RISING diagonal arc from LOW RIGHT to HIGH RIGHT: ready holding dark charcoal school backpack by straps near knees; crouch and pull bag back LOW beside left hip; start rising swing toward right waist; CONTACT backpack HIGH in front of face to the RIGHT, arms up, chest leaning back slightly; followthrough backpack OVERHEAD; settle into high raised bag pose ready for next descending strike. Same backpack size every frame. No trails or loose books.
ROW 4: SECOND BACKPACK strike, DOWNWARD overhead smash: first pose matches row3 last pose with bag already OVERHEAD; pull bag further behind head; bring bag forward above head; CONTACT smash bag sharply DOWN toward RIGHT at opponent waist/knee height, torso bent FORWARD; low followthrough bent knees backpack near RIGHT floor; recover upright controller stance. Bag must be DOWN in frame4, unlike row3 frame4 where bag is HIGH. Preserve backpack silhouette and straps, full prop inside each cell. Distinct grounded weight shifts, anticipation, contact and recovery. Exactly 24 sprites.
specialized:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel art atlas of Chava for a 90s SNK/KOF fighting game. EXACT 6 columns x 6 rows, 36 full-body poses. Solid flat MAGENTA #ff00ff background, NO checkerboard, no white border or halo, strong dark silhouette outline, no shadow, no text. Face and costume EXACTLY match reference: short black hair tan face thick eyebrows, green polo white trim navy trousers green/white/black sneakers. Fixed adult proportions and head scale. Wide gutters. All face RIGHT. Six chronological frames per row. Ground baseline identical per row. Do NOT enlarge crouched poses to fill cells.
ROW1: LIGHT CROUCHING STRAIGHT JAB: compact squat; fist near waist; extending low straight arm; full horizontal quick jab RIGHT at opponent stomach; retract; crouching recovery. Remain low and compact, not an uppercut. Other hand near chest.
ROW2: HEAVY CROUCHING UPPERCUT: deep squat loading fist LOW; windup low fist near hip; rising torso and fist; CONTACT with fist punched UP and RIGHT ABOVE HIS HEAD, attacking elbow bent vertically, fist clearly higher than head, one knee remains deeply bent; uppercut followthrough; recover crouch. This row must be visibly DIFFERENT from row1, no horizontal straight jab.
ROW3: LIGHT CROUCH LOW KICK: compact crouch; lift FRONT foot slightly; extend short low toe poke; CONTACT one leg extended a SHORT distance FORWARD, torso upright in crouch, both hands raised, NO HAND ON FLOOR, heel only just beyond knee; retract; compact crouch. Short low poke, not a long sweep.
ROW4: HEAVY CROUCH SWEEP: deep crouch; turn hips and plant ONE HAND ON FLOOR; extend leg sweeping out; CONTACT FULLY EXTENDED LONG STRAIGHT LEG along ground to RIGHT, body very low with one palm on floor, other knee deeply bent; sweep followthrough; recover crouch. Clear long range and very different silhouette from row3.
ROW5: HEAVY AIR DOUBLE-FIST HAMMER: airborne knees tucked; BOTH HANDS CLASP together above head; begin overhead swing; CONTACT clasped fists smash diagonally DOWN and RIGHT in front of chest, torso curled forward, knees still tucked and feet OFF FLOOR; downward followthrough; airborne recovery. NO single straight punch, NO grounded poses.
ROW6: HEAVY AIR AXE KICK: airborne bent knees; lift attacking leg vertically above head; leg overhead ready to chop; CONTACT long attacking leg extended diagonally DOWN and RIGHT while other knee tucked, torso leaning backward, feet airborne; descending followthrough; airborne recovery. This must be DISTINCT from a horizontal flying side kick. The striking heel points downward in contact frame4. Same body scale everywhere, full extended feet and hands inside cells. No motion trails, no effects, no extra props.
alternates:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite atlas for Chava, matching reference 1's pixel art and reference 2's face. EXACTLY SIX columns THREE rows, 18 full-body sprites. Pure solid #ff00ff magenta background, no checkerboard, NO white halo or outline, no text, no shadows, crisp BLACK pixel outline. Green polo white collar trim, navy trousers green white black sneakers, tan face black short hair. Same body proportions and same head size in EVERY pose. All face RIGHT. Keep full limbs within cells, wide gutters. Six sequential frames per row.
ROW1: LEFT-hand CROUCH CROSS variant. Distinct torso rotation showing BACK of polo during contact, not ordinary front-facing right jab. Frames: low compact crouch guard; far LEFT shoulder pulls back; rotate hips and shoulders showing back; CONTACT punch with LEFT arm FULLY EXTENDED HORIZONTALLY to RIGHT at low height, right elbow BENT guarding torso, body stays crouched; retract; recover crouch. No uppercut.
ROW2: LEFT-hand AIR CROSS variant. Both knees bent and feet off ground throughout. Frames: airborne tuck guard; far LEFT shoulder pulled back; rotate to show BACK of polo; CONTACT fully extended LEFT fist to RIGHT at head height with back visible and RIGHT arm bent guarding chest; retract; recover airborne tuck. Not a hammer punch. No overhead arm.
ROW3: HEAVY STANDING HIGH ROUNDHOUSE KICK, distinct from horizontal waist-level side kick. Frames: reference broad ready stance holding small black controller; transfer weight to supporting leg and turn hip; lift attacking knee HIGH; CONTACT kicking leg FULLY extended diagonally UP to RIGHT at opponent HEAD height, torso leans back, supporting foot stays planted; retract high knee; return initial stance. The kicking heel MUST be at character face height in frame4, not waist height. All six frames same grounded baseline. Crisp fighting game pixel-art anatomy and continuous movement.
